title: Coherence as a Field Phenomenon
description:
Coherence is not accumulated — it flows.
This project introduces a field-based model of coherence governed by resistance, thresholds, and phase transitions, replacing accumulation-based explanations that fail at scale. Electrical and plasma-regime analogies make coherence dynamics observable across materials, information propagation, and complex systems. Diamond growth acceleration appears here as a worked application of the method, not its focus.
For a clearer, continuously updated, and more user-friendly presentation of the framework, see the companion site and live materials on GitHub:
👉 https://smansfield635-create.github.io/control/
